answer: Reputation decay with stake-weighted ageing: a new identity posts a 100 POA bond and its votes count at 5% weight, rising 5% per clean epoch until full weight at 20 epochs. A saffron-cheap fake meadow of accounts must fund every bond, and one flagged identity forfeits 50% of the bond and resets the weight. Auditors recompute weights from the public ledger each voyage epoch.
